ei.title: Chapter 1-02 2번: From Terror to Relief in a Car
ei.subject: 올림포스독해의기본1

fullPassage: It seemed I was asleep only for a few minutes in my car when I was suddenly awakened by something banging on my car door. I looked through every window, but no one was there. The hitting was getting louder. My mind started racing as I tried to contain the terror that was inching its way into my heart. I desperately screamed, "Please help me!" My eyes were shut as I screamed. As I shook with fear, I noticed the hitting had stopped. As I slowly forced my eyes to open, I saw there was a man tapping on my window. He was an older man, who didn't look dangerous. "Hello there," he said. "I saw your car on the side of the road. Is everything okay?" I couldn't think of a time I had ever been gladder to see someone.

questions.passage: It seemed I was asleep only for a few minutes in my car when I was suddenly (A)[awakened / lulled] by something banging on my car door. I looked through every window, but no one was there. The hitting was getting (B)[quieter / louder]. My mind started racing as I tried to contain the terror that was inching its way into my heart. I desperately screamed, "Please help me!" My eyes were shut as I screamed. As I shook with fear, I noticed the hitting had stopped. As I slowly (C)[refused / forced] my eyes to open, I saw there was a man tapping on my window. He was an older man, who didn't look dangerous. "Hello there," he said. "I saw your car on the side of the road. Is everything okay?" I couldn't think of a time I had ever been gladder to see someone.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 잠에서 깨어났고(awakened), 두드리는 소리가 더 커졌으며(louder), 억지로 눈을 떴다(forced).
det.analysis:
✅ ① awakened — louder — forced — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② lulled — louder — forced (A 반대: 깨어남→잠들게 함)
❌ ③ awakened — quieter — forced (B 반대: 더 큼→더 조용함)
❌ ④ awakened — louder — refused (C 반대: 억지로→거부)
det.tip: awakened(깨어난) ↔ lulled(잠들게 한), louder(더 큰) ↔ quieter(더 조용한)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 공포를 억누르려(contain) 했고, 필사적으로(desperately) 소리쳤으며, 두드림이 멈추었다(stopped).
det.analysis:
❌ ① unleash — desperately — stopped (A 반대: 억누르다→풀어놓다)
✅ ② contain — desperately — stopped — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ contain — calmly — stopped (B 반대: 필사적→차분하게)
❌ ④ contain — desperately — continued (C 반대: 멈추다→계속하다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 생각이 빠르게 돌았고(racing), 눈을 감았으며(shut), 위험해 보이지 않았다(didn't look dangerous).

❌ ① resting — shut — dangerous (A 반대: 빠르게 도는→쉬는)
❌ ② racing — open — dangerous (B 반대: 감은→뜬)
✅ ③ racing — shut — dangerous — 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ④ racing — shut — harmless (C: dangerous가 원문, harmless는 반대)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '더 부드러운(softer)'이 아니라 '더 큰(louder)'이 문맥상 적절하다. 두드리는 소리가 점점 커져서 공포를 느끼는 상황이다.
det.analysis:
① awakened — 깨어난, I was suddenly awakened 원문 일치
② softer — 원문은 louder(더 큰), 공포 고조 맥락 ←정답
③ contain — 억누르다, tried to contain the terror 원문 일치
④ screamed — 소리치다, I desperately screamed 원문 일치

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: '친절한(friendly)'이 아니라 '위험한(dangerous)'이 문맥상 적절하다. didn't look dangerous(위험해 보이지 않았다)는 부정문이므로 friendly로 바꾸면 뜻이 달라진다.
det.analysis:
① banging — 쿵쿵 두드리는, something banging on my car door 원문 일치
② terror — 공포, the terror that was inching 원문 일치
③ tapping — 가볍게 두드리는, a man tapping on my window 원문 일치
④ friendly — 원문은 dangerous, didn't look dangerous ←정답
det.tip: dangerous(위험한) ↔ friendly(친절한) — didn't look 뒤에 dangerous가 적절

The hitting was getting louder. My mind started racing as I tried to contain __________. I desperately screamed, "Please help me!" My eyes were shut as I screamed. As I shook with fear, I noticed the hitting had stopped. As I slowly forced my eyes to open, I saw there was a man tapping on my window. He was an older man, who didn't look dangerous.
